title: Battle of the Slices 2026: DoorDash Names Top Local Pizza Spots Across America
summary: From California to Connecticut, DoorDash spotlights some of the country’s top-rated local pizzerias, plus the toppings and pizza styles Americans order most
body_markdown:
October is National Pizza Month and DoorDash is celebrating by serving up its **2026 Top Pizza Spots*** , a list of standout small and medium-sized pizzerias across the country. Last year, Battle of the Slices took us to five of America’s best-known pizza states. This year, we’re taking the battle nationwide.


From[Wedgewood Fernando's Pizza](https://www.doordash.com/store/851451) (Ohio), slinging its Brier Hill-style squares since 1967, to[Coniglio's Old Fashioned Pizza](https://www.doordash.com/store/26305000) (New Jersey), helmed by a ten-time World Pizza Champion, the list celebrates neighborhood pizza spots serving everything from classic New York-style slices and Chicago deep dish, to Detroit-style squares and plenty of local specialties.


> *“What I love about pizza is how local it is. Every neighborhood has a spot people are fiercely loyal to,” said* ***Ruth Isenstadt, Head of U.S. Restaurants at DoorDash.*** *“This list celebrates the restaurants that earn that loyalty order after order, and the people behind them who keep finding ways to make a familiar favorite their own. We’re proud to shine a light on some of those local standouts across the country.”*


### **So, How Does America Order Its Pizza?**


Americans aren’t slowing down on pizza. In 2025, customers placed **nearly 30 million pizza orders**** on DoorDash. Here’s what they were ordering:


-


**Pepperoni still rules –** Pepperoni was America’s **most-ordered pizza topping** , with onion and sausage rounding out the top three.


-


**Caramelized onions are having a moment –** Orders with caramelized onions and meatballs grew **more than 120% year-over-year** .


-


**Pineapple has plenty of fans –** Despite how much people argue about it, Americans ordered pineapple more often than olives, bacon, chicken, or ham.


-


**White pizza came out on top –** With more than **3 million orders** , white pizza was the most-ordered pizza style on DoorDash.


-


**New York-style is on the rise –** New York-style was the fastest-growing major pizza style, with orders jumping **more than 80% year-over-year** , while stuffed crust grew **more than 45%** .


### **The United States of Pizza**


Among this year's standouts are[Zachary's Chicago Pizza](https://www.doordash.com/store/800531) (California) known for its stuffed spinach and mushroom pie, to[Robert's Pizza & Dough Company](https://www.doordash.com/store/681201) (Illinois) and its signature "Za Dough" thin crust, perfected over two decades of brick-oven baking, to[Market Street Pizza](https://www.doordash.com/store/418745) (Texas) and its lineup of specialty pies like street corn and BBQ chicken.

Find local pizza restaurants near you on DoorDash.


** The list of 2026 Top Pizza Spots was generated by analyzing DoorDash data from September 2025 through September 2026. All small and medium-sized restaurants and brands with less than 10 stores, the highest average overall customer rating, and at least 1,000 reviews, qualified for this list.*


*** According to DoorDash data from January through December 2025. Year-over-year growth compares orders during this period with the same period in 2024.*
